title: Smart Survival HUD
description: An all-in-one survival HUD that shows hunger, thirst, temperature, and danger — everything you need to survive, in one clean UI.
body:
# Smart Survival HUD

Smart Survival HUD is a lightweight, all-in-one survival overlay for Fabric that keeps the information you actually need on screen without cluttering your view.

Instead of bouncing between vanilla bars and guessing what is happening around you, this HUD gives you a clean readout for your core survival stats in one place:
- Hunger with saturation
- Biome temperature with live hot/cold state
- Thirst with smooth depletion and water bottle restore support
- Nearby hostile mob danger detection

Built for players who want better awareness during survival, hardcore, and exploration without turning the game into a full overhaul.

## Features

- Clean sci-fi styled HUD panel
- Real-time hunger and saturation tracking
- Temperature monitor based on biome conditions
- Thirst system with gradual depletion
- Water bottles restore thirst
- Danger scanner for nearby hostile mobs
- Optional alert sound and screen flash when danger appears
- Toggle HUD visibility anytime
- Built-in HUD position editing
- Lightweight and fully client-side

## Controls

- `H` - Toggle HUD
- `J` - Enter/exit HUD edit mode
- `Arrow Keys` - Move HUD while in edit mode
- `K` - Reset HUD position

## Configurable

Smart Survival HUD includes a config file so you can tune the experience to your liking, including:
- Enabling or disabling individual HUD modules
- Danger scan radius and mob thresholds
- Thirst max value, drain speed, and restore amount
- HUD default visibility and position
- Danger alerts and dehydration damage

## Why this mod?

Smart Survival HUD is made for players who want survival feedback that feels immediate, readable, and useful. It adds meaningful awareness without spamming your screen or bloating the game with unnecessary systems.

## Requirements

- Minecraft `1.20.1`
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
